veranderings.voor: kan oor en oor ná mekaar sing
veranderings.na: kan oor en oor beurtelings sing
veranderings.rede: 'Beurtelings' says plainly that leader and group take turns; 'ná mekaar' reads wooden here.

veranderings.voor: Hulle volg dikwels ook sulke patrone.
veranderings.na: Hulle volg ook dikwels sulke patrone.
veranderings.rede: 'Ook dikwels' is the natural Afrikaans order of these two adverbs.
'Net so' can read as 'just like that'; 'op dieselfde manier' is clearer for a Grade 6 learner.

veranderings.voor: twee stemme of groepe sing tegelyk verskillende note wat by mekaar pas
veranderings.na: wanneer twee stemme of groepe tegelyk verskillende note sing wat by mekaar pas
veranderings.rede: The definition is a bare main clause; a 'wanneer' clause matches how the other glossary definitions are built.
